properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-18 for Mission Bay's UCSF campus pass: real OSM building footprint for the campus's central utility plant. 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: correction to the entry above. OSM way 135103720 is tagged barrier=fence, landuse=industrial, name 'Mission Bay Preliminary Utilities Plant', operator 'UCSF Mission Bay', with no building tag, so the polygon is the plant's fenced industrial compound and not a real OSM building footprint as first written.
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap outline of the plant's fenced compound (OSM way 135103720 is tagged landuse=industrial with a fence barrier, not as a building), not a hand trace or plan estimate; the polygon is the fenced site, not a building footprint. This is the opposite situation from Mission Bay's condo-mapped residential towers (Avalon, Radiance, etc.): here, ONE large Assessor land parcel spans SEVERAL UCSF buildings (confirmed against data/raw/parcels.geojson and DataSF's Assessor tax roll -- e.g. blklot 8711507 at 675 Nelson Rising Lane alone is ~13 acres, far larger than any single building on it), so using the parcel boundary per building would make multiple records overlap and double-count the same ground. The real building footprint is the only non-overlapping, honest shape for each one.
properties.notes: Existence confirmed (CEQA filings reference a UCSF Mission Bay utility plant/distribution system on Block 16B), but construction date, architect and size were not found in any source checked. The OSM address tag on this feature is 1480 4th St; the CEQA record cited here places the plant on Block 16B but gives no street address. An earlier note that a CEQA record gave 1500 Owens St could not be traced to any record read and was removed on 2026-09-29.
